Description

King’s House School Sports Ground includes two modern 3G synthetic pitch, providing excellent performance in all conditions. Suitable for both football and rugby, this versatile space supports matches, training sessions and community sport. Set beside the River Thames in West London, it reflects the site’s commitment to accessible, high-quality facilities for all users. Please visit https://www.kingshousesportsground.co.uk/
to make a booking.
